item.title: Summer Days
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 0verflow
  • 発売日: 2006-06-23
  • スコア: 6.7700000000000005/10 (228 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Summer Days
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Summer Days is an alternate universe prequel to the game School Days, set in the summer holidays just prior to the timeline of School Days. All the original characters are present, except it assumes that they all first meet during the summer holidays as opposed to during the first year of school. Although Kotonoha and Sekai, the heroines of the first game, are both present, the main heroine is Setsuna.

item.title: Pure Mail
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 0verflow
  • 発売日: 2000-08-25
  • スコア: 6.6/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: PureMail -ピュアメール-
  • 英語名: Pure Mail

あらすじ

Kei has a difficult past with an abusive father and has problems socializing with people directly, so he chooses chatroom acquaintances over real people. But one day he discovers that his chat partner EVE is his classmate Midori, who has a crush on A,W - his internet alias. He falls in love with Midori but hides his idealized A,W identity from her so she would not be deterred by his real self, tainted by past and present events, and blackmailed into a slave-like relationship with the school’s web mistress.

item.title: Large PonPon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 0verflow
  • 発売日: 1999-11-26
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (27 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ら～じPonPon
  • 英語名: Large PonPon

别名

  • らーじPONPON

あらすじ

Our hero’s girlfriend, Rurika, suddenly informs him that she is being transferred to Paris. However, after only a few months, she gives up her job and comes home; she is pregnant. Following an extremely hot argument, she leaves him without telling him where she is going.

Our hero goes looking for her and learns that she has checked into an obstetrics ward. Here at the hospital, he accidentally runs into Yukari, an old childhood friend from school. He also starts up a hot relationship with a married woman named Touri, who is staying in the next hospital room. His girlfriend really starts to get jealous of his other playmates. Will he fulfill his obligations to Rurika, or will he keep going after hot, new babes?
